endpoints.purpose: all stored daily records, newest first
last N calendar days including current day
period total, average, range and record count

notes: Do not treat missing dates as zero without an explicit source definition.
Timezone metadata is not exposed by the API.
No public SLA or rate-limit policy is documented; cache responses and poll at a reasonable frequency.

endpoints.purpose: latest total and operational device counts

notes: Historical scrape dates are not guaranteed to be gap-free.
Do not interpret a missing observation as zero devices.

revenue.revenue_basis: Use the spreadsheet GB per month series for revenue calculations.
revenue.do_not_substitute: Do not substitute daily network-offload API GB for revenue-sheet GB.

pipeline.settlement_note: Projected revenue and received payments are separate stages. Historical settlement has commonly involved a delay of roughly two months, although timing varies. Do not assume a same-month mapping.
pipeline.bbb_transfer_note: Transferred to Buy & Burn is a downstream cash-flow field and should not be inferred directly from projected revenue or daily offload GB.
pipeline.fiat_operator_note: Transferred to Fiat Operators should remain a separate field. Blank historical cells are null/not reported, not automatically zero.
pipeline.outstanding_transfer_note: Balance Outstanding to Transfer is the spreadsheet's source accounting field for funds still outstanding for transfer at that point in the schedule.

revenue.blank_cell_semantics: Treat blank cells as null/not reported unless the upstream source explicitly defines zero.

notes: The feed reconciles carrier cash receipts to their underlying service month or contiguous service months where uniquely supported.
Service-period attribution and cash-settlement dates are both preserved.
Unattributed payments remain visible but are excluded from recognized DeFiLlama revenue.
Projected but unsettled WiFi revenue is excluded.
The DeFiLlama adapter uses settlement dates for ingestion while preserving service-month provenance in this feed.

onchain.guidance: Derive chain-native metrics directly from Solana where practical.

burn_wallets.role_note: The primary BBB/liquidity classification is community-derived. Do not classify every inbound transfer as a completed burn.
